paraphrase: The root verses exhort the practitioner in each intermediate state: in the bardo of life, give up laziness and enter hearing, reflection and meditation; in the bardo of dream, give up the corpse-like sleep of ignorance and recognize the dream; in the bardo of meditation, rest undistracted; in the bardo of dying, give up clinging and enter the clear light; in the bardo of dharmatā, recognize the appearances as self-display; in the bardo of becoming, close the womb door and remember pure perception.
notes: Reference from the unit author's knowledge (not read in a local text in this phase).
